arcSummary: Tamsin collects stories the way others collect scars, and has plenty of both. She is writing the guild's saga. There is one chapter she always skips.

stages.title: The Collection
stages.summary: Campfire. She trades stories like currency and pays out three of her best. Then she takes out the manuscript.

stages.title: The Chapter She Skips
stages.summary: Every saga she tells has a hole in the middle, shaped like a hedge-knight with no hedge and no house.

stages.title: The Shelf That Keeps
stages.summary: She wants one shelf in the frozen library wing — the one place the unmake cannot edit — for the saga. Terms apply.
